services.desc: Argentina, the world’s 8th largest country, encompasses more than 1 million square miles at the southern end of the South American continent (about 1/3 the size of the US). It extends from the Tropic of Capricorn to windswept tundra in Tierra del Fuego, just a few hundred miles from Antarctica. Given its prodigious size, it’s no wonder that Argentina boasts a dazzling array of premier fly fishing destinations as vast and varied. From chasing golden Dorado in tropical marshlands to battling trophy brown trout in Patagonia, anglers will not soon tire of the incredible diversity of fishing that only Argentina can offer. blurb: Faraway Fly Fishing offers guided fly fishing trips and lodges worldwide, including Patagonia, the Amazon, Iceland, and the flats of the Caribbean and Indian Ocean. They only send guests to waters and lodges they have personally experienced. Guests can plan trips targeting various species such as sea trout, trout, salmon/steelhead, golden dorado, jungle species, and saltwater fish.
